# orion type

Card types: what a card is, its fields, face, and states

```sh
orion type <command> [options]
```

## orion type list

List the card types this build knows, from Orion and from sources

```sh
orion type list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion type show

Show a card type's fields, face, states, and meaning

```sh
orion type show [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                   |
| -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `[name]` | The type's name, such as gate |
| `--json` | Print JSON                    |

## orion type attach

Attach a card type to a card, after the ones it carries

```sh
orion type attach [id] [type] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`   | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `[type]` | The type's name, as orion type list shows it                                              |
| `--json` | Print JSON                                                                                |

## orion type detach

Take off a card type a person attached

```sh
orion type detach [id] [type] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`   | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `[type]` | The type's name, as orion type list shows it                                              |
| `--json` | Print JSON                                                                                |
